raw.description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

As the Study Activation Specialist, you are responsible for managing the startup activities of clinical trials proposed and entering those trials into the Sarah Cannon Strategic Sites’ clinical research program menus. You will maintain relationships and facilitate progress across multiple groups including but not limited to internal SC departments, Strategic Sites physicians and staff, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and Pharmaceutical Companies. You will serve as the primary responsible party and point of contact during clinical research trial feasibility, planning, and implementation stages up until the point of site activation.

  • You will develop relationships with sponsors and (CROs), which provide potential studies 
  • You will maintain a database of potential pharmaceutical and CRO relationships 
  • You will market Sarah Cannon services and capabilities to pharmaceutical companies, CROs and within the industry network 
  • You will develop and maintain strong industry ties, utilizing both the network and the Internet, in order to acquire new studies 
  • You will provide information and updates on current studies in the start-up process at all Sponsor meetings 
  • You will track all site metrics relating to the study start up process for each Strategic Site 
  • Other duties as assigned

You should have for this position:

  • High School Diploma required; Bachelor Degree preferred
  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry, regulatory processes, clinical trials and medical terminology 
  • The availability to travel occasionally 
  • At least one year of experience in Customer Service in a Client Facing Role
  • Experience in healthcare, research, pharmaceutical or marketing industries preferred


About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: .

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Summary:

We're hiring an experienced and data driven Operations Manager to lead strategic process improvements, optimize workflows, and align cross-functional teams with business objectives in a fast-growing remote environment.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who thrives in operational problem-solving, enjoys building scalable systems, and can drive accountability, efficiency, and execution across multiple departments.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, proactive, and capable of balancing strategic thinking with hands-on operational leadership.

Why This Role is Unique:

  • High impact leadership role with direct visibility into company operations and growth.
  • Opportunity to optimize and scale systems across multiple departments.
  • Blend of strategy, execution, analytics, team leadership, and operational improvement.
  • Fast paced environment with opportunities to build structure and create measurable impact.
  • Ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges and improving efficiency.

What You'll Own:

  • Operational workflows become more scalable, efficient, and measurable.
  • Cross-functional teams remain aligned with company priorities and execution goals.
  • SOPs, systems, and reporting structures stay organized and actionable.
  • KPIs and operational metrics provide visibility and support strategic decision-making.
  • Process improvement initiatives drive measurable business impact.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Oversee day to day operations to ensure consistency, efficiency, and alignment with company standards.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar operational methodologies.
  • Analyze workflows to improve productivity, reduce inefficiencies, and optimize performance.
  • Support implementation of operational best practices across departments.

KPI Tracking & Performance Management

  • Develop and monitor operational KPIs and reporting dashboards.
  • Create reports and insights for leadership visibility and strategic planning.
  • Track operational performance trends and recommend improvements.
  • Ensure reporting accuracy and consistency across systems and departments.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with leadership teams to align operations with business growth goals.
  • Collaborate across departments to improve communication, accountability, and execution.
  • Support change management initiatives and operational rollouts.
  • Facilitate operational meetings, follow-ups, and workflow alignment.

Documentation & Systems

  • Build, update, and maintain SOPs, workflows, and operational playbooks.
  • Standardize processes and operational procedures across teams.
  • Maintain organized documentation repositories and internal systems.
  • Ensure operational consistency and process adherence across departments.

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Manage and mentor operations team members.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support onboarding, workflow training, and operational guidance.
  • Help teams prioritize effectively and improve execution quality.

Qualifications & Skills:

Required

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in operations management, project management, or process optimization.
  • Proven experience leading operational improvement initiatives with measurable results.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent leadership and communication abilities.
  • Experience building SOPs, workflows, and operational systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in startups, outsourcing, or high-growth environments.

Required Remote Setup

Compensation & Benefits

raw.excerpt: Priory are looking to recruit a Research Associate to support clinical research across our Healthcare services in a 12-month fixed-term contract, working 37.
raw.description:
Priory are looking to recruit a Research Associate to support clinical research across our Healthcare services in a 12-month fixed-term contract, working 37.5 hours per week.
This is a fully remote role, worked from home with occasional visits to Priory sites and our headquarters as required. Appropriate IT equipment, including a laptop, will be provided to support your remote working.
This is an opportunity to contribute to research that helps improve our understanding of patient needs, strengthen clinical risk assessment and evaluate recovery outcomes. Working under the direction of our lead researchers, you will help turn research findings into practical improvements in mental healthcare.

What you'll be doing

You will support the development and delivery of several research projects, including the Priory Acuity Tool, Listening Beyond Words (Peak Profiling), validation of our multidisciplinary risk assessment tools, and Recovery360 outcomes research.
Working closely with researchers and clinical teams across Priory, you will contribute to research design, coordinate project activity, collect and analyse data, and communicate findings.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Conducting literature reviews and database searches to inform research projects.
  • Supporting the development of research frameworks and study designs
  • Collecting, analysing and presenting qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Liaising with Priory hospital sites and multidisciplinary teams to support research participation and engagement.
  • Preparing reports and presenting findings to lead researchers and the Priory Research Committee.
  • Contributing to papers for publication in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Supporting the application of research findings within clinical services.
  • Managing your workload and project resources to meet agreed deadlines.

What you'll bring to the role

You will hold a graduate degree in science and have research experience gained at graduate or postgraduate level. A master’s degree, specialist postgraduate qualification or equivalent experience would be desirable but not essential for this requirement.
We are looking for someone who can combine strong analytical skills with the ability to build effective relationships with clinical colleagues. You will be organised, self-motivated and comfortable working independently as well as within a research team.
You will bring:
  • Knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methods, including data collection and analysis.
  • The ability to summarise and present research findings clearly.
  • Strong critical thinking skills and close attention to detail.
  • Effective written communication, interpersonal and presentation skills.
  • Good planning skills and the ability to work to agreed priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent IT skills and proficiency in relevant data analysis packages.
Experience of conducting research in mental health, or working with vulnerable groups, would be advantageous.

What we will give you in return

We want you to succeed at Priory and thrive in your role. You will be well supported with regular career conversations. We also offer full training and numerous pathways into leadership and qualified clinical positions to help you shape your career with us.
  • 25 days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays + additional day’s leave for your Birthday!
  • Annual leave entitlement increases based on length of service: 27 days after 5 years’ service and 30 days after 10 years’ service
  • Length of service recognition awards – every 5 years
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Initial Disclosure Check Cost covered, if applicable to role
  • ‘My Possible Self’ App and health-related benefits
  • Online discounts and cashback rewards – Priory Perks
  • Smart Technology scheme (qualifying period)
  • Cycle to work scheme (qualifying period)
  • Smart Holidays (qualifying period)
  • Gym Flex (qualifying period)
  • Healthcare Cash Plan – Simply Health Scheme
  • Eye Care Vouchers
  • ‘Cash for Colleagues’ – Employee referral scheme
  • Access to development opportunities
  • Sponsorship of professional qualifications through our Individual Professional Development (IPD) panel
  • Leadership & management development
  • Parental Leave Gift
Please take the time to familiarise yourself with the full job description attached prior to making an application.

Shortlisting may begin upon receipt of applications, and the Recruiting Manager may close the vacancy early if enough suitable candidates are identified.

raw.description:
Principal Biostatistician/ Sr Biostatistician (R/Rshiny - EMEA BASED)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Industry experience as a Biostatistician using R is required. Rshiny would be advantage

Principal Biostatistician - RShiny Specific:
Sets up and maintains excellent R-based computing environment. Adds missing features to apps and fixes bugs in existing apps. screens the market for supplied data visualization tools and integrates internal/external apps into our working environment. Organizes and performs user trainings and is available for user support on demand. Is up to date with the latest technical possibilities available on the global market. Excellent R and R-shiny knowledge thorough experience in clinical data structures and programming with data
expert in functional and object-oriented programming. Knowledgeable in Javascript/Typescript, HTML, WebGL, experience in CUDA/GPU-programing, cloud-computing, Github, web-hosting/ Machine Learning. Strong communication skills and ability to work both, independently and collaboratively, clear in the presentation of complex issues.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serves as a statistical department resource, mentors biostatisticians on job skills, and oversees or develops training plans or materials for Biostatistics associates. Conducts training sessions, or otherwise trains new hires and enhance the skills of existing personnel.

  • Directs the activities of other biostatistics personnel on assigned projects to ensure timely completion of high quality work. Provides independent review of project work produced by other biostatisticians in the department.

  • Provides support across all statistical tasks during the lifecycle of the project, from protocol to CSR.

  • Prepares or oversees the preparation of Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), including development of well-presented mock-up displays for tables, listings, and figures. Collaborates with sponsor, if required.

  • May be responsible as Lead Biostatician for the statistical aspects of the protocol, generation of randomization schedule, and input to the clinical study report.

  • Creates or reviews programming specifications for analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures.

  • Reviews SAS annotated case report forms (CRFs), database design, and other study documentation to ensure protocol criteria are met and all data is captured as required to support a high quality database and the planned analysis.

  • Implements company objectives, and creates alternative solutions to address business and operational challenges.

  • As biostatistics representative on project teams, interfaces with other departmental project team representatives

  • Preparing in advance for internal meetings, contributing ideas, and demonstrating respect for opinions of others.

  • Conducts and participates in verification and quality control of project deliverables, ensuring that output meets the expected results and is consistent with analysis described in the SAP and specifications.

  • May lead complex or multiple projects (e.g. submissions, integrated analyses), and attend regulatory agency meetings or responds to questions, as needed, to support the statistical analysis results of clinical trials on behalf of the sponsor.

  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects, sets goals based on priorities from management, discusses time estimates for completion of study related activities with biostatistics management, adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload, and proactively communicates to biostatistics management any difficulties with meeting these timelines.

  • Monitors progress on study activities against agreed upon milestones and ensures the study timelines for project deliverables are met. Identifies out of scope tasks and escalates to management.

  • Provides statistical programming support as needed.

  • May participate in Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) and/or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) activities, including charter development and serving as an independent non-voting biostatistician. May serve as a voting statistician on DSMBs and/or DMCs.

  • Provides input and reviews, and subsequently follows applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).

  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, and verification/quality control documents and programs; ensuring inspection readiness.

  • Displays willingness to work with others and assists with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business.

  • Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others

  • Supports business development activities by contributing to proposals, budgets, and attending sponsor bid defense meetings.

This is a remote position.

Role:Head of AI Enablement & Transformation
Company:Vulcury Consulting
Location:Flexible (remote with periodic collaboration)
Compensation:Base + revenue share + equity participation tied to practice performance

About Vulcury Consulting

Vulcury Consulting is the advisory and execution arm ofVulcury, a venture studio and consulting platform that builds and scales sophisticated businesses. Our consulting practice supports both external clients and internally incubated ventures across strategy, technology, operations, and growth.

Unlike traditional consultancies that focus on slide decks and recommendations, Vulcury is structured todesign and implement real systemsthat drive measurable business outcomes.

One of the most significant opportunities today isAI transformation—the replacement or augmentation of legacy software and manual workflows through agentic systems, intelligent automation, and modern AI infrastructure. Vulcury is building a dedicated practice focused on delivering these capabilities to clients.

The Opportunity

Vulcury is seeking aHead of AI Enablement & Transformationto build and lead our AI implementation practice.

This role is effectively the leader of atechnology implementation consultancy focused on deploying AI solutions. The practice will design and implement systems such as:

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate knowledge work

  • AI copilots that augment existing teams

  • AI-native tools replacing legacy SaaS platforms

  • AI-powered operational automation across departments

In many cases, Vulcury will bebuilding custom AI systems for clients, integrating LLMs, orchestration layers, APIs, and internal data systems.

The person in this role will lead bothclient development and delivery, building a profitable consulting vertical while leveraging Vulcury’s infrastructure, talent network, and venture studio ecosystem.

The role is designed for someonea few years out of an MBA or strategy/technology consulting careerwho recognizes that the traditional partnership track at large firms can take a decade. Instead, this person is excited tobuild a practice now, operating with significant autonomy and sharing directly in the upside created.

While candidates may eventually have built their own AI consultancy, the ideal person prefers toaccelerate that journey within Vulcury’s platform, gaining access to delivery infrastructure, technical collaborators, and an existing client ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Build and Lead the AI Transformation Practice

  • Establish and lead Vulcury’s AI enablement and transformation practice.

  • Define service offerings around:

    • Agentic workflow design and deployment

    • AI automation of operational processes

    • Replacement of legacy SaaS tools with AI-native systems

    • AI copilots for internal teams

    • AI infrastructure integration with existing data systems

  • Develop repeatable frameworks for assessing AI opportunities inside client organizations.

Client Development

  • Bring an initialclient network or book of businesswhere possible.

  • Develop new client relationships through thought leadership, partnerships, and targeted outreach.

  • Identify AI transformation opportunities within Vulcury’s consulting and venture studio ecosystem.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Lead the design of AI-enabled workflows and systems for client organizations.

  • Coordinate with Vulcury engineers, analysts, and technical specialists to build solutions.

  • Oversee deployment, testing, and iteration of AI systems within client environments.

Practice Economics

  • Own theP&L of the AI transformation practice.

  • Develop scalable delivery models combining advisory, engineering, and implementation.

  • Recruit and mentor technical consultants and AI specialists as the practice grows.

Advisory Strength in Agentic AI

The AI enablement practice will be supported by advisory input from asenior leader in agentic AI at a global financial institution, providing strategic perspective on emerging architectures and enterprise adoption patterns.

This relationship ensures the practice remains aligned withcutting-edge developments in AI-driven operational transformation.

What Makes This Different

This is not a traditional consulting job.

You will be:

  • Building and owning a new consulting practice

  • Delivering real AI systems rather than theoretical transformation plans

  • Leveraging Vulcury’s infrastructure rather than building from scratch

  • Participating directly in the upside you create

Instead of spending a decade navigating a consulting partnership track, this role offers the opportunity tobuild a high-value AI consulting franchise immediately.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is structured to reflect the entrepreneurial nature of the role.

Components may include:

  • Competitive base salary

  • Revenue share from AI consulting engagements

  • Equity or profit participation tied to practice performance

  • Participation in broader Vulcury upside depending on long-term role

Top performers in this role should expect compensationclosely aligned with the value they create for clients and the practice.

​

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for abuilder who understands both consulting and modern AI capabilities.

Typical background may include:

  • MBA from a leading program

  • 3–7 years experience in one or more of:

    • Strategy consulting

    • Technology consulting or digital transformation

    • AI implementation within a startup or enterprise

    • Building or deploying AI tools internally

  • Familiarity with modern AI architecture including:

    • LLM-based systems

    • agentic workflows

    • automation platforms

    • API integrations

  • Experience working with executive stakeholders on technology initiatives

  • Demonstrated ability to originate business or manage client relationships

The ideal candidate likely:

  • Has begun buildingclient relationships or advisory engagements

  • Recognizes the limits of large consulting firms

  • Is motivated byownership and autonomy

  • Wants to build a practice with real economic participation


Benefits

Why Join Vulcury

Vulcury is designed as a platform for builders.

You will have access to:

  • A venture studio launching new technology businesses

  • Existing consulting infrastructure and delivery teams

  • A network of engineers, analysts, and operators

  • Opportunities to design and deploy cutting-edge AI systems

For the right person, this role is an opportunity tobuild a modern AI implementation consultancy with meaningful ownership and long-term upside.

​

raw.description:
Willkommen im Customer Growth Team bei der shopware AG! Als führendes E-Commerce-Unternehmen suchen wir einen leidenschaftlichen Key-Account Manager (m/w/d) für unsere strategisch wichtigsten Enterprise-Kunden.

Deine Aufgabe ist es, unsere Kunden nicht nur zufriedenzustellen, sondern zu begeisterten Fans zu machen. Werde unser zentraler Ansprechpartner für Key-Accounts (wie z.B. Poco, ThyssenKrupp und Stabilo), steigere mit deinen Fähigkeiten den After-Sales-Service und trage dazu bei, die Kundenzufriedenheit auf ein unerreichtes Level zu heben. Wir suchen deutschlandweit nach einem Key-Account Manager (m/w/d), der bereit ist, in einem dynamischen E-Commerce-Umfeld zu wachsen und maßgeblich zum Erfolg von Shopware beizutragen. Egal, wo du dich befindest, du wirst ein integraler Bestandteil unseres Teams sein.

Requirements

  • Key-Account Management: Deine Hauptverantwortung liegt in der Pflege und Entwicklung strategischer Partnerschaften mit unseren Schlüsselkunden. Dabei strebst du langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen an, um das Umsatzwachstum sicherzustellen.

  • Kundenbetreuung: Du bist für die umfassende Betreuung zugewiesener Key-Accounts verantwortlich. Dein Fokus liegt darauf Opening, Closing und Retention.

  • Umsatzsteigerung: Identifikation von Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten. Du vertreibst die Produkte unserer Technologiepartner (z.B. Payment & Shipping-Provider). Du trägst damit dazu bei, den Umsatz zu steigern und die Churnrate niedrig zu halten.

  • Kundenzufriedenheit: Du gewährleistest hohe Kundenzufriedenheit durch proaktive Kommunikation, Lösung von Problemen und Sicherstellung, dass die Erwartungen der Kunden erfüllt werden. Persönliche 1:1-Beziehungen, regelmäßige Strategie-Meetings und ein effektiver Onboarding-Prozess spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams: In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Marketing, Produktentwicklung und Technical Support sorgst du dafür, dass die Anforderungen der Kunden optimal erfüllt werden. Du agierst als Schnittstelle zu internen Fachspezialisten und stellst sicher, dass Bestandskunden den bestmöglichen Support erhalten.

  • Branchenmessen und Networking: Du nimmst aktiv an Branchenmessen teil, um Beziehungen zu pflegen, zu networken und langfristige, strategische Partnerschaften mit den Top-Kunden (Online-Umsatz von ca. 50 Mio. €). Dies trägt dazu bei, das Unternehmen in der Branche zu positionieren und das Kundenportfolio weiter auszubauen.

  • Teilnahme an zentralen Teammeetings am Campus in Schöppingen (ca. 6x/Jahr)

Das bringst du mit:

  • Nachweisbaren Erfolgen: Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfolge im Bereich Key-Account Management, vorzugsweise im E-Commerce oder der Softwarebranche.

  • Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Du besitzt exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich. Du überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten, Argumentationsstärke und ein hohes Maß an Empathie.

  • Selbstständigkeit: Du zeigst die Fähigkeit zur selbstständigen Arbeit, organisierst dich und deine Aufgaben optimal und auch proaktive Problemlösung gehört zu deinem Skill-Set.

  • E-Commerce-Kenntnisse: Du bringst grundlegendes Verständnis für die E-Commerce-Branche mit und bist an den neuesten Trends und Entwicklungen interessiert.

  • Beziehungsmanagement: Du hast ein gutes Händchen für Beziehungsmanagement und hast Erfahrung mit großen Accounts in IT-nahen Bereichen.

  • Vertriebsfähigkeiten: Du kannst Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten identifizieren, und damit proaktiv deine Vertriebsziele verfolgen. Bei uns kannst du deine Quota übertreffen und deine erfolgreiche Karriere ausbauen.

  • CRM-Erfahrung: Du bist es gewohnt mir einem CRM-System zu arbeiten (z.B. HubSpot oder Salesforce).

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.

Position : Part-Time Digital Marketing & Social Media Specialist

Salary : PHP 35,000 - 65,000

Working Hours & Conditions : AU Time

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

We are a premier, established hospitality and entertainment group based in the heart of the Sydney CBD. Operating a portfolio of high-end, exclusive venues, we specialize in delivering world-class, premium experiences to a discerning clientele.

Because we operate in a highly competitive, age-gated lifestyle and entertainment niche, our brand requires sophisticated, compliant, and highly creative marketing strategies. We pride ourselves on maintaining an exceptional reputation offline, and we are looking for a digital specialist to help us scale that luxury experience across our organic online channels.

OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a highly creative, strategic, and technically savvy Digital Marketing & Social Media Specialist to manage and grow our online presence across multiple platforms.

Because we operate in a highly regulated, age-gated lifestyle and entertainment industry, this is not a standard social media role. Success in this position requires someone who deeply understands how social media algorithms work, knows how to maximize organic reach while navigating strict platform content restrictions, and can continually adapt as community guidelines evolve.

The ideal candidate is highly experienced in SEO, AI-powered content creation, and organic social media growth, with the ability to think strategically while executing daily marketing activities.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Social Media Growth

  • Plan, create and publish engaging content across:
    • Instagram
    • Facebook
    • TikTok
  • Post daily (often multiple times per day) to maximise organic reach.
  • Schedule and manage content calendars.
  • Monitor engagement and optimise posting times.
  • Build audience growth through organic strategies.
  • Respond to trends quickly and capitalise on viral opportunities.

Algorithm & Platform Strategy

A critical part of this role is understanding how modern social media algorithms operate.

You will be expected to:

  • Stay ahead of Instagram, Facebook and TikTok algorithm changes.
  • Develop strategies that maximise visibility and engagement.
  • Minimise content suppression ("shadow banning") where possible.
  • Understand platform policies and work within them.
  • Continually test new content formats and posting strategies.
  • Analyse performance and adjust campaigns accordingly.

This role requires someone who enjoys experimenting, testing and improving—not simply scheduling posts.

SEO & Website Marketing

  • Improve website search rankings.
  • Conduct keyword research.
  • Optimise website content.
  • Create SEO-friendly blog articles.
  • Monitor Google Search Console and Analytics.
  • Identify new organic traffic opportunities.

AI Content Creation

The successful candidate should be highly competent with modern AI tools.

Responsibilities include:

  • Using AI to generate high-quality content.
  • Creating images and marketing assets.
  • Producing captions, articles and campaign ideas.
  • Building AI workflows to improve productivity.
  • Researching and implementing new AI tools as they emerge.

We're looking for someone who understands how AI works, not someone who simply copies and pastes from ChatGPT.

Digital Marketing

Assist with broader digital marketing initiatives including:

  • Email marketing campaigns.
  • Landing page optimisation.
  • Campaign reporting.
  • Competitor research.
  • Marketing analytics.
  • Promotional campaign planning.

Digital Billboard Campaigns

Support outdoor digital advertising campaigns by:

  • Creating digital billboard artwork.
  • Coordinating campaign schedules.
  • Managing creative updates.
  • Monitoring campaign performance where applicable.

Reporting

Provide regular reports covering:

  • Website traffic
  • SEO performance
  • Social media growth
  • Engagement metrics
  • Content performance
  • Recommendations for continual improvement

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS:

Essential

  • 3+ years' experience in Digital Marketing.
  • Strong SEO knowledge.
  • Advanced Instagram knowledge.
  • Strong Facebook Business Suite experience.
  • Strong TikTok marketing experience.
  • Experience growing social media accounts organically.
  • Excellent understanding of social media algorithms.
  • Experience using AI tools for marketing.
  • Strong written English.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Highly organised and proactive.
  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience marketing in highly regulated or restricted industries.
  • Experience working around advertising limitations while remaining compliant with platform policies.
  • Graphic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar).
  • Video editing (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar).
  • Google Analytics.
  • Google Search Console.
  • SEMrush, Ahrefs or similar SEO platforms.
  • Experience with digital outdoor advertising.
  • Basic bookkeeping or administrative skills to support the business as it grows.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

  • Creative and innovative.
  • Analytical and data-driven.
  • Adaptable to constant platform changes.
  • Curious and always learning.
  • A problem solver who enjoys testing new ideas.
  • Self-motivated and reliable.
  • Commercially minded with a focus on business growth.

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

raw.excerpt: About Us Join us in helping patients with rare diseases.
raw.description:
About Us
Join us in helping patients with rare diseases. At Egetis Therapeutics we challenge the status quo for the benefit of those in need. We offer an open, positive and supportive culture where everyone can be their best. Through trust, we work seamlessly across functions. As an employee you are empowered and encouraged to have an entrepreneurial spirit, enjoying an organization with conscious and efficient decision-making and we take pride in our collaborative working environment! In February 2025, the European Commission approved Egetis’ Emcitate® (tiratricol) as the first and only treatment of peripheral thyrotoxicosis in patients with monocarboxylate transporter 8 (MCT8) deficiency (Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome). In March 2026, the U.S. FDA accepted the filing of Egetis’ New Drug Application (NDA) for Emcitate® (tiratricol) for the treatment of MCT8 deficiency and granted Priority Review. The Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date is September 28, 2026.
As a courageous, committed, and collaborative organization, we are seeking to grow our team to drive success both in the pre-launch and post launch phases. For more information, please visit our website at www.egetis.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

Our Values
Courageous - Challenge the status quo for the benefit of the patient
Committed - Operate with high ethical standards through an efficient organization to deliver top quality results
Collaborative - Through trust, work seamlessly across functions and with external partners

Purpose of the role
The Director, Clinical Development provides the medical and scientific leadership required to oversee the design, conduct, and interpretation of assigned clinical study(ies) within the tiratricol programs and other Egetis development projects. Acting as the study physician, the role holder serves as the primary medical point of accountability for study-level clinical strategy, participant safety, data integrity, and scientific quality, working cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, and external investigators and vendors, under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Egetis headquarters is in Stockholm, Sweden, and we welcome applications from candidates based anywhere within the Central European timezone (CET/CEST) with no relocation required. Stockholm-based or near-by area applicants are equally welcome to work from our office.

Duties and Responsibilities

Clinical strategy and study design
  • Provide medical and scientific input into the study concept, target product profile, and clinical development plan for the assigned indication.
  • Author or co-author the clinical sections of the study protocol, including objectives, endpoints, eligibility criteria, dosing rationale, and estimands; ensure scientific and ethical integrity of the design.
  • Contribute to protocol synopses, amendments, and the design of the schedule of activities, ensuring feasibility and alignment with regulatory expectations.
  • Provide clinical input into case report form (CRF) design, edit checks, and the data management and monitoring plans.
Medical oversight of study conduct
  • Act as the study physician / medical monitor, providing day-to-day medical guidance to sites, Clinical Operations, and the CRO throughout study conduct.
  • Review eligibility questions, protocol deviations, and dose-modification decisions; respond to investigator medical queries in a timely manner.
  • Provide medical input into monitoring strategy, site selection, investigator engagement, and study start-up activities.
  • Support recruitment and retention through medical education of sites and development of study-specific medical guidance and FAQs.
Participant safety and pharmacovigilance
  • Serve as the medical reviewer for adverse events and serious adverse events at the study level; perform ongoing medical review of safety data in collaboration with Pharmacovigilance.
  • Contribute to safety management plans, benefit-risk assessment, causality and expectedness assessment, and signal detection for the study.
  • Support preparation of safety sections of the Investigator's Brochure, DSUR, and aggregate safety reports; contribute to Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) activities where applicable.
  • Escalate emerging safety findings to the Chief Medical Officer and the Benefit-Risk / safety governance bodies.
Data review, analysis and interpretation
  • Lead ongoing medical/clinical data review to ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity throughout the study.
  • Provide medical input into the statistical analysis plan; participate in database lock, unblinding, and interpretation of study results.
  • Interpret efficacy and safety findings in the clinical and scientific context and translate them into clear conclusions for internal and external audiences.
Scientific documentation and communication
  • Author or provide senior medical review of key study documents, including the clinical study report (CSR), informed consent templates, and clinical narratives.
  • Contribute clinical content to regulatory submissions (e.g., IND/IMPD, briefing books, MAA/NDA modules) and to responses to health-authority questions.
  • Support abstracts, manuscripts, and congress presentations arising from the study, ensuring scientific accuracy and compliance with publication standards.
Regulatory, ethical and quality compliance
  • Ensure study conduct complies with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations (FDA/EMA), the Declaration of Helsinki, and Egetis SOPs.
  • Provide medical input into interactions with regulatory authorities, ethics committees / IRBs, and support inspection readiness.
  • Ensure that study-level activities uphold the ethical and scientific integrity of the development program and core labeling texts.
Cross-functional collaboration and external engagement
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Medical Affairs, and CMC to deliver the study on time, on budget, and to quality standards.
  • Engage key opinion leaders, investigators, scientific advisors, and patient organizations; organize and synthesize expert and advisory-board input into study strategy.
  • Provide medical oversight of CROs and specialty vendors (e.g., central labs, ECG, imaging, ePRO/eCOA) at the study level.
  • Contribute to feasibility, timelines, budget, and risk management for the assigned study.

Qualifications and experience

  • Medical degree (MD or equivalent); specialist training and/or clinical practice experience desirable (e.g., endocrinology, pediatrics, internal medicine, or a relevant rare-disease field).
  • Minimum 5 years experience as a study physician / medical monitor in biopharmaceutical clinical development. Experience in interventional clinical trials, ideally including late-stage development).

raw.description:
Building: Thanks to an expertise constantly evolving since 1968, we have exceptional know-how for every type of construction project and we have the advantage of being both diversified and specialized. Mindful of costs, deadlines, health and safety, and the environment, we apply the strictest standards of the industry in each of our activity sectors.

Each project is unique in its design, context, schedule and budget. When analyzing and controlling these factors, we are able to suggest an effective work method that fits the client’s specific expressed needs, priorities and requirements.

Though we are recognized for large-scale projects such as office buildings, hospitals and research centers, educational institutions, residential buildings, hotels, shopping malls, factories and sports and cultural centers, our team excels in unique mandates such as renovations, restorations or upgrades. Whether these are in Traditional, Construction management, Design-Build or Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) contracting methods, we work with the same rigor to exceed customers’ expectations.

Working for the Building Division, the Estimator prepares estimates of probable costs for every project (public, parapublic, private, industrial, commercial, institutional and multi-unit residential) for which the Company has decided to enter the bidding process.

Responsibilities

Upon receipt of tender documents, the duties include:

  • review the plans, drawings and specifications;
  • generate the tender price schedule, time schedule, approximate quantities required for work and materials;
  • question the work methods, possible subcontracts, risks and constraints with the tender;
  • attend the mandatory site visit before tendering and/or any client information meeting;
  • obtain prices from the subcontractors and suppliers;
  • determine all costs associated with the issuance of the bid and the special conditions;
  • balance each page of the tender price schedule with the total quantities, total labour, equipment, material, subcontractors and suppliers costs;
  • perform calculations for the material quantities;
  • provide the Chief Estimator/Senior Estimator with the total bid amount;
  • keep in touch with owners, subcontractors and suppliers for clarifications and guidelines;
  • provide full construction work schedule;
  • prepare the bid reviewing;
  • maintain strong relationships with owners, subcontractors, suppliers, etc.

Conditions

Requirements

  • college Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or comparable;
  • bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Engineering is an asset;
  • at least 10 years experience;
  • ability to read and interpret plans, drawings and specifications;
  • computer knowledge: MS Project, Timberline, Windows, Excel, Outlook, Internet, On-screen take-off;
  • bilingual is an asset.

Skills and attitudes required

  • observation skills;
  • accuracy;
  • strong organizational, planning and analytical skills;
  • sense of teamwork;
  • swiftness, efficiency and professionalism;
  • discretion, autonomy and good judgment;
  • carefulness with deadlines;
  • tolerance to stress.

Avantages

Conditions offered by EBC

  • a competitive salary;
  • 4-weeks’ vacation per year;
  • a comprehensive group insurance program accessible upon hiring (health & dental component paid by the employer);
  • a group RRSP program with an employer contribution to a DPSP;
  • an employee assistance program;
  • an active social club;
  • a friendly and stimulating work environment;
  • large-scale projects;
  • company «recognized as one of the 2019 Best Managed Companies in Canada».

Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas desenvolvedoras para construírem aplicações mais seguras, ajudando empresas a alcançar maior maturidade em desenvolvimento seguro, mitigar riscos e proteger o que importa: seus negócios. Somos movidos pela inovação, investindo em pesquisa e novas tecnologias para transformar a cultura de segurança de aplicações em todo o mundo.

Aqui, acreditamos que grandes resultados vêm de pessoas apaixonadas por hacking e que compartilham o compromisso de tornar o mundo mais seguro. Nossa cultura é transparente, colaborativa e focada no aprendizado contínuo. Além disso, somos um time anywhere office com uma equipe que trabalha em mais de 34 cidades diferentes e cada Insider (nossas pessoas colaboradoras) tem liberdade para crescer de onde quiser.

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora Frontend (Jr/Pleno) na Conviso, você será responsável por construir e evoluir interfaces de uma plataforma de segurança de aplicações, entregando features de ponta a ponta com Vue 3 e TypeScript, GraphQL e design system, com foco em visualização clara de riscos, qualidade, testes, performance e acessibilidade.

💻 Trabalho remoto, impacto global.

Está pronto(a) para transformar desafios em soluções e crescer com a gente?

Vem para a Conviso! 💙💛

✨ SEU DIA A DIA

  • Entregar features de ponta a ponta, participando do refinamento com Produto e Design até a publicação em produção, sempre com testes e code review;
  • Construir e evoluir interfaces com Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Quasar e o design system interno;
  • Modelar e consumir dados via GraphQL, lidando com grandes volumes de informações, filtros, paginação e estados de carregamento e erro;
  • Desenvolver visualizações e tabelas densas que tornem riscos de segurança fáceis de entender e priorizar;
  • Reutilizar e evoluir o design system, criando novos componentes somente quando houver necessidade justificada;
  • Escrever testes automatizados junto com cada entrega;
  • Cuidar de performance, acessibilidade, internacionalização e tamanho de bundle em uma SPA de grande porte;
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews, contribuindo para a evolução técnica do time;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com pessoas de Produto, Design e Backend para criar soluções que resolvam problemas reais de quem desenvolve software.

👀 É IMPRESCINDÍVEL TER

  • Conhecimento em JavaScript moderno e TypeScript;
  • Experiência com Vue 3 e Composition API ou experiência sólida com React ou Angular, com interesse em trabalhar com Vue;
  • Domínio de HTML semântico e CSS, incluindo layout, flexbox, grid e especificidade;
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs REST ou GraphQL e no gerenciamento de estados assíncronos;
  • Prática em escrever e ler testes automatizados;
  • Familiaridade com Git e fluxo de code review;
  • Comunicação escrita clara para colaborar em PRs, issues e documentações;
  • Inglês para leitura técnica e escrita de código, commits e PRs.

⚡ SERÁ UM DIFERENCIAL

  • Experiência com GraphQL e Apollo Client;
  • Conhecimento em Quasar, Vitest, Pinia, Histoire ou ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência na criação ou manutenção de design systems;
  • Vivência com interfaces orientadas a dados, tabelas densas, filtros e visualizações;
  • Conhecimento de acessibilidade, internacionalização e performance em aplicações grandes;
  • Contato prévio com segurança de aplicações, incluindo conceitos como ASPM, SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, CVSS, CWE e OWASP Top 10.

Informações adicionais

😉INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Você fará parte de uma squad com duas pessoas de Frontend e trabalhará em uma aplicação viva, com áreas maduras e outras em constante evolução. O time conta com design system documentado, testes automatizados, feature flags, monitoramento via Datadog RUM e code review obrigatório.

A diferença entre os níveis está no grau de autonomia:

  • Júnior: entrega tarefas bem definidas com qualidade, pede ajuda quando necessário, navega em uma base de código grande e usa feedbacks de review como aprendizado.
  • Pleno: conduz features completas, desdobra entregas, negocia escopo, antecipa impactos e apoia o desenvolvimento de colegas.

Não esperamos que você conheça toda a stack no primeiro dia, nem que seja especialista em segurança. Valorizamos curiosidade, colaboração, qualidade e vontade de aprender.

Se você atende a boa parte dos requisitos, candidate-se mesmo assim. Preferimos avaliar pessoas a descartá-las por checklist.



🎁BENEFÍCIOS

Além de trabalhar em uma empresa onde você pode se desenvolver enquanto faz parte integralmente do negócio, oferecemos benefícios para tornar nossos dias ainda mais agradáveis!

Senior Director, State Policy & Strategy - Western Region

College Board - Global Policy & External Relations

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team 

The Global Policy & External Relations Policy and Advocacy team shapes the policy, partnership, and external conditions that allow College Board programs to reach more students and retain public trust. The team sits at the intersection of program strategy, state policy, government relations, higher education, state and district partnerships, engagement, research, and external influence.


The State Policy and Strategy function is a new state growth strategy vertical within Policy and Advocacy. It is designed to move College Board from reactive state work to a disciplined, proactive model that names the few state moves that matter most, aligns leaders on tradeoffs, and turns enterprise priorities into sequenced state plans.

 

About the Opportunity  

States are making consequential decisions about course access, assessment, career-connected learning, credit recognition, teacher credentialing, and the future meaning of college and career readiness. These decisions shape whether AP, SAT Suite, BigFuture, and career-connected initiatives can reach students at scale — and how College Board grows its programs in an increasingly complex state policy environment.


The Senior Director, State Policy and Strategy — Western Region will own a portfolio of state strategies that translates College Board’s policy priorities into sequenced, actionable state plans. This means building the fact base for Western Region states, identifying where state conditions create opportunity or risk, making the case for where to invest and where to hold, and aligning internal partners around the plays that matter most.


This is a senior strategy role with real influence over where College Board places its bets at the state level. Success requires the ability to synthesize complex political and policy landscapes quickly, work fluently across multiple policy domains without needing to own any single one, and lead cross-functional teams toward clear decisions in an organization where expertise, relationships, and execution are distributed across many strong partners.

In this role, you will: 


Build and Own Regional State Strategy

Develop and maintain a current fact base for every Western Region state — including policy conditions, political and governance dynamics, coalition strength, program opportunities, implementation barriers, and risk. Translate that intelligence into concise state plans that show the complete picture: goals, current and pursued policies, external actors, internal owners, available levers, sequencing, and implementation needs.


Recommend priority states and plays to the Executive Director based on policy opportunity, student reach, adoption potential, feasibility, and College Board priorities. Connect regional strategy to AP, SAT Suite, BigFuture, and career-connected education priorities — including 0-to-1 AP growth, SAT School Day, AP Career Kickstart, and BigFuture opportunity pathways. Align regional planning to College Board planning cycles, legislative sessions, and sales cycles so state work moves from episodic response to deliberate sequencing.


Translate Policy Priorities into State Strategy and Rapid Response

Translate policy priorities, analysis, and issue guidance developed by subject-matter experts into regional state strategies. Identify where state conditions create the strongest opportunities for AP, SAT Suite, BigFuture, and career-connected priorities. Assess state-specific timing, political feasibility, governance pathways, coalition strength, opposition dynamics, and student-reach potential.


During legislative sessions, triage bills, regulations, budget proposals, and policy signals; determine when subject-matter expertise is needed; and synthesize implications for state strategy, escalation, and execution. Adapt arguments, policy options, and model language to state context in close partnership with subject-matter experts. Distinguish must-have priorities from opportunistic plays so College Board can pursue a limited number of high-upside state bets while keeping core programs on track.


Drive Cross-Functional Alignment and Execution

Serve as the regional strategy lead for state plays that require coordination across Policy, Government Relations, State and District Partnerships, Higher Education, AP, College Readiness Assessments, BigFuture, Engagement and Reach, Legal, Research, and the Office of the CEO. Clarify what College Board should pursue, sequence, or pause in regional states when resources or strategic priorities require tradeoffs.


Create clean handoffs to execution partners — including State and District Partnerships, Government Relations, State Innovation & Acceleration, and program teams — and maintain the trackers, dashboards, state briefs, decision memos, and executive updates that make priorities, risks, owners, and progress visible. Capture lessons from legislative sessions, state plays, and implementation handoffs and translate them into repeatable practices, playbooks, and recommendations for the next cycle. Engage externally in high-leverage moments with legislators, executive branch officials, coalitions, higher education actors, and partners when the strategy requires a clear and coordinated College Board voice.

About You 

 To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in education policy, state strategy, public affairs, government, advocacy, management consulting, or a related field, with significant and direct exposure to state policy and implementation across multiple states.
  • Established presence, networks, and familiarity with the political and policy landscape of the Western Region, which includes California, Oregon, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii, Arizona, Colorado, Utah, Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming.
  • Working fluency across K-12, higher education, workforce, assessment, CTE, credentialing, and state legislative and regulatory environments — broad enough to engage credibly across issue areas and to know when and how to bring in subject-matter experts.
  • A strong record leading complex, multi-state policy work and influencing senior partners and external stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Exceptional strategic judgment: the ability to identify the few moves that matter, make tradeoffs explicit, and distinguish a prioritized strategy from an inventory of activity.
  • Excellent writing and synthesis skills, including the ability to turn complex state landscapes and expert input into concise briefs, decision memos, state plans, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Experience with legislative session rapid response, coalition and stakeholder mapping, implementation planning, and external advocacy in complex political environments.
  • Proven ability to drive alignment and clear decision-making across organizations where subject-matter expertise, government relations, field execution, program ownership, and senior leadership sit in different places.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in public policy, education, law, public administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Ability to travel approximately 6–10 times per year.
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. 
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process 

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $108,000–$175,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Our team feel Leidos is a great place to work. Learn more about our culture and benefits by visiting us here


Do Work That Matters

Leidos Australia delivers IT and airborne solutions that protect and advance the Australian way of life. Our 2000 local experts, backed by our global experience and network of partners, are working to solve the world’s toughest challenges in government, intelligence, defence, aviation, border protection and health markets.


Your New Role and Responsibilities


We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst for a 6 month max tenure contract who can combine strong communication skills with technical understanding to bridge the gap between business needs and delivery outcomes. This role will suit someone who is confident working with diverse stakeholders, comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and capable of driving clarity, alignment and momentum across Agile projects.


This role will support work connected to the Australian Digital Health Agency’s digital health environment, contributing to initiatives that strengthen secure, connected and interoperable healthcare services across Australia. The project context includes nationally significant health information platforms such as My Health Record, helping improve access to key health information for consumers and healthcare providers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Apply a good balance of communication and technical skills to understand business domain knowledge and translate needs into clear actionable business requirements.
  • Engage confidently with stakeholders across different levels and areas such as architecture, clients, project management, testing and development teams
  • Elicit, analyse, breakdown and maintain a well structured backlog of requirements using online requirements management platforms such as Azure DevOps
  • Able to influence and drive direction in large discussions or workshops to help teams reach practical outcomes
  • Seasoned practitioner in Agile projects and able to not only participate, but run and organise day to day as well as larger agile ceremonies.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively to support delivery within an ambiguous environment
  • Use sound negotiation and problem solving skills to help stakeholders align on a common positive outcome
  • Health domain knowledge preferable but not mandatory

About You and What You'll Bring

  • Relevant bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and Agile certification
  • Extensive experience leading requirements in complex technology environments, facilitating stakeholder workshops and governance forums, and coaching embedded analysts/systems engineers.
  • Strong track record producing clear, testable requirements and user stories, running review and approval processes, and maintaining end‑to‑end traceability in Jira.
  • Proven impact analysis across systems, data, processes, operations and security; effective management of risks, assumptions and dependencies; and definition of measurable, testable non‑functional requirements.

This role does require the successful applicant to be an Australian Citizen and hold a minimum Baseline level clearance.


Diverse Team Members, Shared Values and a Common Purpose

Providing our customers with smarter solutions takes an incredible team with diversity of thought, experience and perspectives driving innovation. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture and is one of our core values. It's about creating a workplace where everyone can do important work, feels welcome, valued, and respected, and has equal access to opportunities to thrive. Paul Chase – Chief Executive, Leidos Australia.


Leidos Australia is an equal opportunities organisation and is committed to creating a truly inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, culturally and linguistically diverse people, people with disabilities, veterans, neurodiverse people, and people of all genders, sexualities, and age groups.


Our five Advocacy Groups (Women and Allies Network, Young Professionals, Defence & Emergency Services, Action for Accessibility and Abilities and Pride+) provide an opportunity for team members to connect and collaborate on shared interests, and work to support and celebrate our diverse community.

  • Recruitment process - virtual / face to face interview & background checks.
  • Applicants may also need to meet International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements. In certain circumstances this can place limitations on persons who hold dual nationality, permanent residency or are former nationals of certain countries as per ITAR 126.1.
  • We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all candidates. Please contact our Careers team if you’d like to discuss any additional support during your application or throughout the recruitment process.

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

HBX Group is empowering the world of travel. We bring together global and local brands in accommodation, transport, activities, and payments through our network of over 300,000 hotels and 60,000 high‑value clients across 140 source markets.
Tech‑driven, customer‑first, and powered by our people, HBX Group is guided by the belief that tech + data + people is what sets us apart. With our “global approach, local touch” philosophy, Team HBX Group is encouraged every day to move fast, dream big and make the difference.

We are seeking a proactive and detail‑oriented professional to support our Commercial Legal function. The role also involves reviewing drafted documents and coordinating with directors, external advisers, and global local offices to gather input, collect signatures, and finalize documentation.   • Strong business ethics and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
  • Team‑oriented, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.

raw.description:
We Are:
We are Technology Strategy and Transformation (TS&T), and we design and execute industry-relevant reinventions that allow organizations to realize exceptional business value from technology. Our vision is to become the world’s leading advisors in harnessing technology and innovation as a force to reinvent and improve every business. As AI fundamentally reshapes how organizations compete, operate, and create value, we help leaders make the strategic technology choices required to turn new capabilities into enterprise advantage. Our mission is to help client business executives disrupt their industry and utilize technology to capture market share.


The Enterprise Architecture practice serves as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders by helping organizations define and implement the technology architectures that drive business value, manage complexity, and accelerate IT modernization. The rapid advancement of AI is fundamentally changing the pace and nature of that work by compressing transformation timelines, introducing new layers of architectural complexity, and pushing leaders to rethink how their technology estates are structured, governed, and evolved. Our practitioners must now extend beyond multi-year planning to architect solutions that learn, adapt, and scale alongside an ever-changing technology landscape. We help clients navigate this new reality by building a clear, business-driven vision of their target state architecture and developing practical roadmaps that account for both near-term AI opportunity and long-term structural resilience. Our Enterprise Architects bring industry-leading principles and methods across technology, data and analytics, security, cloud, and platform architecture to shape the technology agenda and embed EA as a core enabler of business strategy. This includes helping clients integrate intelligent capabilities into their architecture practice, using AI to sharpen analysis, accelerate decisions, and future-proof their technology foundations.

You Are:
A consulting professional with a passion for leveraging emerging and leading-edge enterprise architectures to power business and technology transformation. You are results-oriented and self-directed, with experience shaping, selling, and delivering strategic Enterprise Architecture engagements. You continually build your knowledge of emerging technology, AI, and architecture trends and apply them to develop innovative approaches that deliver client value. You have a flair for breaking down complex problems into logical parts and constructing analyses that lead to actionable recommendations. You bring strong communication and interpersonal skills, a natural ability to build relationships, and a collaborative approach to problem solving. As a Manager/Sr. Manager, you appreciate diverse perspectives and bring out the best in the teams around you. You have a strong aspiration to deepen your enterprise architecture expertise and play a meaningful role in the EA practice and the broader Accenture EA community.


In Enterprise Architecture you will:

  • Cultivate Accenture's role as a trusted advisor to clients, translating business strategy into enterprise architecture decisions that drive measurable value
  • Assess the impact of client business strategy on the architecture landscape across organization, information, infrastructure, and application domains, including where AI creates new capability opportunities or structural risk
  • Lead the design and implementation of enterprise architecture strategies, operating models, and roadmaps
  • Lead the creation of architecture blueprints for complex technology environments, incorporating AI and intelligent capabilities as core architectural components
  • Evaluate the technology portfolio and identify opportunities to reuse, replace, or modernize architectural components to drive strategic value
  • Develop a deep understanding of industry dynamics and the impact of technology and AI trends to formulate recommended changes to existing enterprise architectures
  • Identify and define the EA capabilities, roles, and skills that position clients for long-term architecture maturity in an AI-enabled environment
  • Integrate AI-driven tools and methods into architecture analysis and decision-making to accelerate insight and improve the quality of client recommendations
  • Support sales and business development efforts, including contributing to proposal development and helping grow Accenture's EA presence across accounts
  • Navigate the Accenture global network and leverage relevant expertise to develop enterprise architecture insights and solutions
  • Lead large-scale technology transformation programs that deliver measurable business value through the evolution and governance of enterprise architectures

As a Manager/Sr. Manager you will:

  • Lead a major workstream, owning delivery accountability and ensuring the quality and timeliness of team outputs
  • Coach junior team members through active feedback and deliverable reviews, building EA capability within the engagement team in support of Senior Manager leadership
  • Actively participate in Accenture's internal development programs, including new joiner buddying, internship mentoring, and community initiatives that reflect the firm's commitment to growing its people
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships that extend beyond the workplace, cultivating the organic trust and personal rapport that drives long-term client loyalty and commercial opportunity
  • Support the shaping, selling, and delivering of strategic Enterprise Architecture opportunities, contributing to proposal development and account growth
  • Engage with strategic partner ecosystem providers to inform and strengthen client architecture recommendations
  • Drive development of thought leadership, assets, and offerings that present innovative insights and recommendations on market-relevant Enterprise Architecture topics, including the intersection of AI and enterprise architecture strategy

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s What You Need:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience defining and implementing complex enterprise architectures
  • Minimum 4 years of experience creating roadmaps and developing business cases
  • Minimum 2 years of technology/architecture consulting experience at a consulting firm
  • Minimum 2 years of experience leading teams, facilitating client workshops, and developing architecture recommendations
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points if:

  • Experience in the Resources, Health, CMT, FS industry
  • Broad experience and knowledge of common architecture challenges and approaches for addressing them
  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts, their architectural implications, and how they are reshaping enterprise technology strategy
  • You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree
  • You have deep functional or industry experience in specific Enterprise Architecture components
  • You have Enterprise Architecture industry certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • You have hands-on experience incorporating emerging technology, AI, generative AI, or machine learning capabilities into enterprise architecture strategy or solution design
