Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.

• Ensure adherence to GCP/ICH and regulations; support activities and reviews and provide input to various study relevant documents, safety findings and protocol deviations.

• identify barriers and implement mitigation strategies. Gather and communicate clinical/medical insights from various internal and external stakeholders to optimize trial execution and inform strategy.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Job Title: Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation

Reports To:Chief Technology Officer

Location: Remote – US

Job Type: Full-Time, Regular Position

Company Overview:

Asymchem, Inc., is part of Asymchem Laboratories Co. Ltd., founded in 1995 as a global integrated Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) providing drug R&D and manufacturing for leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Our mission is to drive smarter, greener, and more cost-effective manufacturing to support clinical research and commercialization. Asymchem currently operates R&D and manufacturing facilities in China, the U.S., and the U.K., offering solutions ranging from early clinical stage to commercial stage, including R&D, cGMP production of advanced intermediates, APIs, formulations, and clinical research services. Asymchem Group, headquartered in Tianjin, P.R. China, is a publicly traded company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 002821.SZ/6821.HK).

Asymchem Company Information and Social Media

Job Overview:

The Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation advance Asymchem’s chemical engineering capabilities to support the next generation of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. Building on Asymchem’s existing technical strengths, this leader will work with teams across the organization to advance process engineering, expand continuous manufacturing, and accelerate progress toward more automated, data-driven operations. The role will extend successful technologies and practices across client programs and global sites. Working closely with the Chief Technology Officer and existing technical and operational leaders, this VP will shape technology priorities, develop talent, and guide investments that connect scientific innovation with manufacturing execution. The opportunity is to influence Asymchem’s technology direction while delivering measurable progress in engineering capability and manufacturing performance.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Partner with technical and operational leaders to continuously improve engineering capabilities, technical practices, and cross-site collaboration. Translate shared priorities into a roadmap with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Support the development of engineering talent across the US, Europe, and China. Mentor technical leaders, share effective methods, and contribute to recruitment aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Strengthen process understanding, measurement, modeling, and control to enable reliable automation. Connect laboratory development with manufacturing requirements from the outset.
  • Partner with manufacturing, automation, and digital teams to develop and validate approaches that integrate PAT, process models, and data-driven decisions. Apply AI where it offers demonstrable process value.
  • Prioritize opportunities for automated and continuous processing, demonstrate their value, and lead the engineering work required for adoption in manufacturing.
  • Advance capabilities in reaction engineering, continuous processing, crystallization, solid-form and particle engineering, and separation and isolation. Select technologies against process needs, safety, robustness, and economics.
  • Translate successful approaches into platforms that can be reused across client programs. Extend relevant capabilities from small molecules to peptides, oligonucleotides, and emerging modalities.
  • Guide critical engineering decisions through scale-up, technology transfer, and commercialization. Work with process chemistry, analytical, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams to resolve complex process challenges.
  • Engage clients on technical strategy and due diligence. Translate engineering capabilities into credible development and manufacturing solutions that strengthen client confidence and business opportunities.
  • Partner with the CTO and functional leaders to identify opportunities for technology advancement, shape long-term priorities, and guide investment in people, equipment, and external partnerships.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies with scientific rigor and implementation discipline. Build academic and industry collaborations, develop future technical leaders, and represent Asymchem in senior technical discussions.

Experience Requirements - Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities (KSAs):

  • PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Substantial pharmaceutical development, engineering, or manufacturing experience, typically 15+ years, with increasing leadership responsibility. Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CDMO backgrounds are welcome.
  • Demonstrated success advancing engineering capabilities or technology platforms, developing talent, and translating technical progress into sustained operational results.
  • Strong chemical engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more relevant process technologies, and the breadth to lead specialists. A record of successful scale-up, technology transfer, or commercial implementation is essential.
  • A collaborative leader who develops talent, earns trust across functions, and advances technical priorities through shared ownership and disciplined implementation.
  • Credibility with clients, technical experts, and executives; sound process safety and quality judgment; and the ability to lead across functions, cultures, and locations.
  • Bilingual English and Mandarin a plus, but not required.
  • Experience implementing process automation, advanced controls, or continuous manufacturing is desirable.
  • Experience with peptides or oligonucleotides and external technology partnerships are desirable.
  • Domestic and International Travel as required. Approximately 40%

Benefits:

  • Day 1 Coverage for Medical, Vision (Co. Paid), and Dental Insurance
  • Paid Life Insurance; Short-Term Disability (STD) & Long-Term Disability (LTD)
  • Paid Holidays, Vacation, Sick Time, and Maternity Leave
  • Matching 401K

Build. Lead. Transform.

Why This Role Matters

raw.excerpt: Vitalograph is a global leader in medical respiratory diagnostics, designing and manufacturing innovative devices, software and services that help improve patient lives.
raw.description:
Vitalograph is a global leader in medical respiratory diagnostics, designing and manufacturing innovative devices, software and services that help improve patient lives. Our respiratory diagnostic solutions are used worldwide by healthcare professionals, occupational health providers and clinical trial organisations to support the detection, diagnosis and management of respiratory conditions.

Why join us?
• Join an organisation with a strong reputation for innovation, quality and respiratory health expertise.
• Work on solutions with global reach, helping shape products used by clinicians and customers across international markets.
• Collaborate with experienced clinical, engineering, software, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, customer support and marketing teams.
• Play a highly visible product leadership role, translating user needs, clinical insight and technical understanding into clear product direction.
• Benefit from opportunities for professional growth in a product-led, purpose-driven environment.

Here’s what you can look forward to:
• Generous Time Off – 23 days of annual leave to recharge and unwind
• Financial Security – Excellent company contributed pension & 4x salary death-in-service benefit
• Comprehensive Healthcare – Company contributed private medical insurance for your well-being
• Ongoing learning support

The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced, product-focused Global Product Manager to lead the comPAS PFT Solutions portfolio, spanning both software and hardware products. Reporting to the EVP comPAS PFT Solutions, you will act as the Product Champion for the portfolio, providing clear product leadership across the organisation and ensuring alignment between user needs, clinical requirements, technical development and product lifecycle priorities.
This is a product management role with a strong focus on product strategy, roadmap ownership, requirements definition and cross-functional delivery across connected respiratory diagnostic software and hardware solutions. You will turn customer and clinical insight into well-defined product direction, ensuring the portfolio continues to meet user needs, regulatory expectations and Vitalograph’s long-term product vision.

Key responsibilities:
• Own and maintain the global product roadmap for the comPAS PFT Solutions portfolio.
• Translate user needs, clinical insight, workflow requirements and software and hardware technical considerations into clear product strategies and product requirements.
• Define, prioritise and manage software and hardware product requirements, ensuring they are well understood by development, quality, regulatory and operational teams.
• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Software Development, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Manufacturing, Customer Support, Marketing and Commercial teams.
• Guide product developments through Vitalograph’s Product Approval & Change Evaluation process, maintaining a clear focus on product quality, usability, compliance and customer value.
• Coordinate product readiness activities, including internal communication, release planning, training inputs and launch preparation.
• Monitor product performance, customer satisfaction, competitor activity and market trends to identify opportunities for product improvement.
• Manage product lifecycle activities from concept through development, release, optimisation and retirement.
• Analyse customer complaints, post-market surveillance, usability feedback and Voice of Customer data to inform product decisions and recommendations.
• Represent the product portfolio in customer and partner discussions, workshops and industry events where product insight, user feedback or technical product knowledge is required.

About you
You will be an experienced product management professional with a strong background in both software and hardware product environments, and the ability to balance user needs, clinical requirements, technical feasibility, regulatory expectations and product lifecycle priorities. You will be comfortable working with cross-functional teams, making evidence-based product decisions and providing clear direction in a regulated healthcare or medical device environment.

Essential experience and skills:
• Significant product management experience within medical devices, healthcare, diagnostics or life sciences, with demonstrable experience across both software and hardware products.
• Experience managing connected software and hardware product portfolios, ideally including diagnostic devices, embedded systems, platforms, applications or related healthcare technologies.
• Proven ability to develop and maintain product roadmaps, product requirements and product lifecycle plans.
• Experience working within regulated medical device or healthcare technology environments.
• Strong product strategy, requirements management and product lifecycle management capability.
• Ability to interpret user needs, clinical workflows, usability feedback and technical constraints.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and presentation skills.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across technical, clinical, operational and customer-facing teams.
• Customer-focused, evidence-based decision making.
• Strong organisational and project management skills.

As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has 27,000+ employees in 35 countries. Some 20,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

Job Description

Sales Director

Locations: Remote Brazil

Get To Know Us:

SS&C Calastone is the largest global funds network, connecting the world’s leading financial organizations

Our mission is to reduce complexity, risk and costs, enabling the industry to deliver greater value to investors. More than 4,500 clients in 58 countries and territories benefit from Calastone’s services, processing over £250 billion of investment value each month.

SS&C Calastone is headquartered in London and has offices in Luxembourg, Hong Kong, Taipei, Singapore, New York and Sydney.

The Sales Director is in charge of growing profitable revenues with a portfolio of Calastone ‘Strategic’ and ‘Growth’ clients and having overall accountability for the execution of Calastone’s client sales strategy

What You Will Get To Do:

High Level Objectives

  • Manage increases in client revenue with existing and additional specified product solutions.
  • ldentify cross/up sell target for specified product solutions.
  • Work in partnership with internal teams to become our clients’ trusted business partners.
  • Contribute to building the Calastone brand and franchise across the client base, industry participants and relevant bodies across Brazil.

Key Responsibilities – External

  • Accountable as the Calastone lead with product solutions for clients new business and sales activity, engaging across each client’s key stakeholders.
  • Identify and manage opportunities for networking across different industry groups to support the interests of Calastone customers.
  • Strategically profile Calastone with clients on a regular basis in line with corporate messaging.
  • Achieve deep understanding of each client’s strategic priorities, goals, challenges and their expectations from a service provider.
  • Connect ‘high & wide’ across the decision and influence centers within the client organization and fully grasp the political landscape in the client organization.
  • Deploy Calastone executives in a senior coverage capacity to enhance C-level connectivity.
  • Understand our client specific competitive landscape and develop competitor counter-strategies.
  • Maximize the impact to clients of Calastone thought leadership/industry insights.
  • Seek to create a tangible client specific value proposition that is compelling & differentiating.
  • Meter relationship and service efforts and resources according to the strategic and economic value to the organization.
  • Following appropriate training, be able to deliver basic product demonstrations to clients and prospects, showcasing Calastone’s core capabilities.

Key Responsibilities – Internal

  • Build & maintain concise Client Profile to drive a rigorous annual client strategy review with key Calastone executives and management.
  • Accountable as the lead on the specific client strategy engaging key internal stakeholders in support.
  • Accountable for the quality, accuracy & timeliness of defined client data on Salesforce.
  • Provide accurate revenue forecasts monthly and annually.
  • Develop strong and open working relationships with all internal stakeholders including Management, Sales & RM, Operations, Client Delivery, Marketing, Legal, Finance & Development.
  • Provide up to date product and industry knowledge as well as organizational updates.
  • Study industry news, data & trends to establish Calastone's market position.
  • Execute client strategies in line with our new Sales & RM methodology and process.
  • Identify areas of new business growth and present within our new Sales & RM process.

What You Will Bring:

Required Knowledge & Experience

  • Demonstrated success in sales management, engaging effectively with colleagues and clients across all levels — from operational teams to senior executives — within the funds industry.
  • Experienced in developing and delivering sales and client strategies in collaboration with diverse internal stakeholders, ensuring operational and service excellence.
  • Strong understanding of Calastone’s business and the wider funds industry, including fund trading processes, the strategic objectives of key participants (such as distributors, fund managers, service providers, custodians, and market operators), and the relevant regulatory frameworks.

Person Specification

  • Builds strong and trusted relationships at all levels, from operational teams to senior executives.
  • Proactive in identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities.
  • Demonstrates clear focus, organization, and follow-through.
  • Communicates effectively and confidently, with the presence to influence key decision-makers.
  • Brings an entrepreneurial mindset while respecting and championing corporate discipline.
  • Skilled in managing demonstrations across all Calastone products and services.
  • Operates with honesty, integrity, and professionalism at all times.
  • Articulate and able to communicate well in written and spoken Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Competent in IT and comfortable using a range of digital tools.

Location

Nice to have

raw.description:
Are you an experienced full service Project Manager in the field of clinical trials who’s engaged in addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology. Are you passionate about impacting the health and lives of patients around the world? Do you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in trial operational delivery?

Precision for Medicine are looking to hire a Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager with experience in Oncology who have managed full service clinical trials within a CRO setting to join our global team.

In this pivotal role you will have full service oversight for clinical projects across global/regional (ph I-IV) trials, within Oncology. Accountable for clinical project delivery, oversight of all functional departments, and ensuring agreed timelines, scope, cost and quality.

Involved in all study stages, including proposal strategy, development, costing, and bid defence, and seeing studies through the full cycle to completion, managing the client relationship, project team and budget and timelines throughout.

You will work in a cross-functional team with both internal and external stakeholders, driving quality and coordinating the study team.

We offer an amazing high-energy, dedicated, collaborative team members who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments. If you are no stranger to taking charge and seek positive teamwork to deliver extraordinary work, we have an opportunity for you.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

  • You will independently lead clinical projects in accordance with the study budget and scope of work. You will use your strong interpersonal and organizational skills to set and achieve objectives in the execution of the projects; both contracted objectives and financial objectives. You may be called upon to run international trials as well.
  • Serve as the primary point-of-contact liaison with the client to provide excellent customer service, including participation in proposal activities and client presentations
  • Liaise with Project Team and senior management of both Precision and sponsors, including C level
  • Handle and lead all aspects of a clinical research trial or trials
  • Total project management for all functional areas including data management, safety, clinical, medical monitoring and biostatistics, etc.
  • Prepare project status updates for clients and management; identifying key deliverables and performance metrics of success and escalation.
  • Serve as an active member of the Project Team with the goal to contribute towards efficient management and execution of trials
  • Prepare and reviews protocols and other study documentation such as project plans, inform consents, site contracts and budgets

Requirements:

  • Degree or similar related life science qualification, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Previous experience in a full service/global Project Management role working in the CRO industry is essential.
  • Extensive experience working within Clinical Operations position within a CRO, and at least 4 years full service Project Management experience in a clinical trial setting working for a Clinical Research Organisation.
    • Experience managing studies within Oncology
    • Working understanding of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process
  • Ability to drive and availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays
  • Be able to communicate effectively in the English language both written and spoken
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Proven computer skills (MS Office, MS Project, PowerPoint) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS)
  • Proven ability to develop positive working relationships with individual and teams internally and externally
  • Demonstrated core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities as it relates to the execution of a clinical development plan

Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development.

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at .

raw.description:
About Logile

Logile is the leading retail labor planning, workforce management, inventory management and store execution provider deployed in thousands of retail locations across North America, Europe, Australia, and Oceania. 

Our proven AI, machine-learning technology and industrial engineering accelerate ROI and enable operational excellence with improved performance and empowered employees. Retailers worldwide rely on Logile solutions to boost profitability and competitive advantage by delivering the best service and products at optimal cost. 

From labor standards development and modeling to unified forecasting, storewide scheduling, and time and attendance, to inventory management, task management, food safety, and employee self-service — we transform retail operations with a unified store-level solution. Gain the Advantage with The Logic of Retail. One Platform for store planning, scheduling and execution. 

For more information, visit 

About the role

The Customer Success team is an integral part of Logile’s ability to ensure customers find the most value in their implementation and have continuous support in achieving their business goals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and maximizing their lifetime value within the assigned customer portfolio. This will be accomplished by delivering a great customer experience and expanding the use of Logile products, as well as delivering results and value that exceed customer expectations. Through the relationship the CSM cultivates, you will assist in achieving customer success and growth by identifying add-ons and additional product or services opportunities. The Customer Success Manager will be involved in each assigned project, beginning with project readiness, to help assess and define each customer’s long-term goals. During this time, the CSM will develop relationships with key customer stakeholders and position themselves as a resource for the customer’s team. Additionally, the CSM will act as an advocate for the customer’s needs and goals after each project implementation. This will take many forms including conducting regularly scheduled touch base calls with customer representatives, driving QBRs, managing escalated tickets, and advising internal Logile teams on how to best approach a customer’s needs.

Responsibilities

The Customer Success Manager will represent multiple customers and is responsible for the customers’ long-term success from the time they begin their partnership with Logile. Primary responsibilities are broken into 5 key areas:

Customer Relationship & Strategic Partnership

  • Establish strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders across all levels of assigned customer organizations.
  • Act as the customer’s strategic advisor and internal advocate, ensuring their goals and feedback inform product development and service delivery.
  • Conduct regular Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) to assess performance, surface new opportunities, and align strategic objectives.

Value Realization & Success Planning

  • Partner with customers to co-develop Success Plans with clear goals, KPIs, and milestones aligned to their desired outcomes.
  • Proactively monitor product adoption, usage trends, and health scores to drive retention and prevent churn.
  • Identify and remove barriers to adoption by leveraging customer enablement resources, training, and best practices.

Account & Renewal Coordination

  • Proactively monitor all upcoming renewals, including key contractual usage metrics.
  • Execute simple renewals where there are not substantive changes to the contractual agreement, ensuring timelines, value, and customer satisfaction are managed efficiently.
  • Collaborate with Account Managers on strategic renewals and expansion opportunities, ensuring seamless execution.
  • Develop strong advocates across the assigned customer portfolio.
  • Maintain key metrics within the Logile Customer Success platform necessary for tracking and communicating key Customer Success metrics within the company.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Product, Support, Sales, and Implementation teams to ensure a consistent and valuable customer experience.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable enablement materials, such as onboarding guides and success playbooks.
  • Provide insights to the Product team based on customer feedback and usage trends to influence roadmap decisions.
  • Act as a point of escalation for support and relationship issues including Ticket Escalation and Resolution concerns.

Internal Enablement & Team Contribution

  • Mentor and support junior Logile team members to build internal capability.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of customer success processes and tools.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction, loyalty, and Net Promoter Score (NPS).

Success Metrics

  • Customer Retention Rate: Drive renewals by consistently delivering value and cultivating strong, long-term customer relationships.
  • Customer Health Score: Monitor and improve customer engagement and satisfaction using established health scoring frameworks.
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): Maintain high CSAT scores across all touchpoints, including onboarding, support, and ongoing interactions.
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS): Enhance customer advocacy and increase referral opportunities by delivering exceptional experiences.

Qualifications

  • 5-10 years or more of demonstrated customer success management experience, preferably within the retail industry.
  • Comfortable operating as a peer to senior leadership, challenging assumptions respectfully and driving alignment on key initiatives.
  • Experience with Workforce Management software, best practices, and strategies.
  • Experience with large retail organizations and familiarity with their needs and goals.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams on large scale software implementations.
  • Outstanding leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex organizational problems.
  • BS/BA diploma in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or similar.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office Suite (including Excel, PowerPoint), or other reporting tools.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Logile is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

raw.description:
About Rocket Clicks

At Rocket Clicks, we help Family Law Firms grow through focused, performance-driven digital marketing.

We are not a generalist agency. We are building the definitive growth partner for family law firms by combining deep marketing expertise, real law firm operating experience, and a disciplined approach to execution.

Our team thrives on solving hard problems, improving client performance, and building trusted long-term relationships. We care about results, and we also care about how the work gets done.

Our culture is rooted in six core values:

  • Proactive – We anticipate opportunities and act before problems arise.
  • Disciplined – We remain focused and committed to excellence.
  • Candid – We communicate clearly and directly.
  • Empathetic – We understand and respect the perspectives of others.
  • Accountable – We take ownership of results, good or bad.
  • Results-Oriented – We focus on outcomes, not busyness.

If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home at Rocket Clicks!

The Ideal Candidate

You love solving puzzles and figuring out how things work. You notice small details that others miss, and you always want to make things better.

You can't help but ask questions — it's just how you're wired. 'Why does this work?' 'What if we tried that?' 'How can I get better at this?' This constant curiosity drives your growth, both personally and in the results you deliver. When you do something, you do it well because you care about quality.

You get real satisfaction from helping others succeed and watching your own skills level up. You're always asking 'how can this be better?' and you're not afraid to try new ideas.

If this sounds like you, you'll fit right in here.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day execution and optimization of digital advertising campaigns across search, social, and programmatic platforms. Reporting to the Paid Media Manager, this role focuses on implementing Rocket Clicks’ playbooks, monitoring campaign performance, and supporting strategic decision-making for Family Law Firm clients.

As a hands-on contributor, you’ll manage paid media accounts within Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms. You’ll be responsible for ensuring campaigns are built correctly, tracking is functioning accurately, and performance aligns with established KPIs. You’ll collaborate closely with your Paid Media Manager to deliver exceptional results and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities & Objectives

  • Campaign Execution & Optimization
    • Execute Rocket Clicks’ industry-specific playbooks and First Principles methodology.
    • Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, and Programmatic ad platforms.
    • Proactively optimize campaign performance through data analysis, bid adjustments, audience segmentation, and creative testing.
    • Ensure accurate tracking, reporting, and delivery settings.
    • Maintain proper pacing against budgets and planned media mix.
    • Partner with design and editing teams to deliver high-performing ad creative.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting
    • Monitor daily and weekly performance, proactively identifying risks and opportunities.
    • Audit accounts regularly to ensure alignment with best practices and strategic goals.
    • Assist in the implementation and troubleshooting of conversion tracking for campaigns.
  • Collaboration & Client Support
    • Participate in team brainstorming sessions to test new ideas.
    • Work directly with your Paid Media Manager to translate client goals into actionable campaign tasks and ensure all work aligns with the overall strategy.
    • Actively participate in sprint planning, take ownership of your tasks, and consistently provide clear updates to your team on progress and blockers.
    • Collaborate with the SEO and Project Management teams to ensure paid media initiatives are integrated with broader marketing efforts and that client goals are met seamlessly.
    • Document client-specific learnings, experiments, and playbook updates.
  • Operational Excellence
    • Execute effectively against a clear roadmap of tasks spanning at least two weeks in advance.
    • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.
    • Contribute to team documentation and process refinement.
    • Ensure work meets quality standards, deadlines, and budget expectations.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

  • Campaign ROI / ROAS: Consistently achieves or exceeds performance benchmarks, contributing to a portfolio average of 95% or higher goal attainment.
  • Budget Adherence: Campaigns stay on target and maintain pacing accuracy.
  • Data Accuracy: Tracking, tagging, and reporting remain reliable and any discrepancies are resolved within 24 hours.
  • Task Completion: Work is delivered on time within the sprint framework maintaining a 95% or higher sprint completion rate.

What It Takes To Succeed In This Role

To thrive as a Paid Media Specialist at Rocket Clicks, you should bring a balance of analytical ability, platform fluency, and accountability.

  • Analytical Mindset: Skilled at interpreting data and identifying actionable insights.
  • Platform Proficiency: Working knowledge of Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
  • Detail-Oriented Execution: Ensures campaigns are built and maintained with precision.
  • Curious & Growth-Minded: Continuously learning new tools, tactics, and features.
  • Collaborative Communicator: Works effectively within cross-functional teams.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2-4 years of professional experience in digital marketing.

Experience

  • Demonstrated success optimizing campaigns to achieve or exceed key performance metrics such as CPL, ROAS, or cost-per-lead efficiency.
  • Proven ability to manage $20,000+ in monthly ad spend across multiple clients or brands, ensuring strong pacing, targeting accuracy, and budget utilization.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining campaigns within:
    • Paid Search: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads
    • Paid Social: Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads (or similar platforms)
    • Programmatic: StackAdapt, Simpli.fi, The Trade Desk
  • Strong understanding of conversion tracking and analytics, including setup, QA, and troubleshooting via tools such as Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.
  • Experience interpreting data and creating actionable performance reports using tools such as Looker Studio or platform dashboards.
  • Prior agency or client-facing experience preferred — especially within performance-driven or lead generation industries.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing, creative experimentation, and campaign iteration based on data-driven insights.
  • Exposure to automation tools, scripts, or AI-driven optimization is a plus.

Benefits

  • 10 Paid Vacation Days per year
  • 5 Paid Sick Days per year
  • Paid Company Holidays per year
  • Maternity Leave
  • Paternity Leave
  • Bereavement Leave

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8AM-5PM Central Standard Time

Work Location: Remote - PH (Philippines)

raw.description:
Overview

We are seeking experienced Real Estate Review Appraisers to serve as the agency’s subject matter experts for appraisal reviews related to right-of-way acquisitions, easements, and partial takings. These positions will ensure appraisal products comply with Federal standards, USPAP, and the Uniform Appraisal Standards for Federal Land Acquisitions (UASFLA). The ideal candidates will hold the MAI designation from the Appraisal Institute, , and/or the ARA designation from the American Society of Farm Managers and Rural Appraisers (ASFMRA), and a Certified General Real Property Appraiser license, with demonstrated experience reviewing complex appraisal assignments for federally funded infrastructure projects. In addition, the candidates will hold a Certified General Appraiser license following standards set by the Appraiser Qualifications Board.

The agency’s increasing workload in right of way acquisition and federally funded infrastructure projects requires senior-level review appraisers with the highest professional credentials. The MAI or ARA designation is critical to ensuring appraisal credibility, compliance, and defensibility in eminent domain cases and project funding approvals. These positions will reduce risk of litigation, increase efficiency in acquisition processes, and provide expert oversight of appraisal contractors.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

LMI has been named a 2024 #BestPlacestoWork in the United States by Built In! We are honored to be recognized as a company that values a people-centered culture, and we are grateful to our employees for making this possible!

Responsibilities

  • Review, analyze, and approve appraisals for right of way projects, corridor acquisitions, easements, and eminent domain proceedings.
  • Ensure technical compliance with UASFLA, USPAP, and Federal regulations.
  • Provide written appraisal reviews and recommendations to leadership.
  • Serve as a resource and advisor to project managers, attorneys, and acquisition specialists regarding valuation methodology.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior appraisers and acquisition staff.
  • Represent the agency as an expert witness in administrative hearings and court proceedings.
  • Develop and maintain internal guidance, policies, and training related to appraisal and review processes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • MAI (Appraisal Institute) or ARA (ASFMRA) designation.
  • Certified General Appraiser license following standards set by the Appraiser Qualifications Board.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in real estate, finance, economics, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressively responsible real estate appraisal experience with at least 3 years in review appraisal for federal land acquisition projects.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of UASFLA (Yellow Book), USPAP, 49 CFR Part 24 (Uniform Act), and eminent domain appraisal practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to prepare review reports and provide expert testimony.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Federal or State agency experience with right of way acquisition programs.
  • Experience coordinating with legal counsel, engineers, and acquisition specialists.
  • Knowledge of federal land acquisition regulations and relocation assistance programs.
  • Prior service as a review appraiser for federal land acquisition, corridor or large-scale infrastructure projects.

Target salary range: $100k - 140k

Disclaimer:

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

raw.description:
We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew.

Senior Editorial Writer

ModSquad | Marketing | Contractor/Freelancer

About the Role

ModSquad is executing a brand-led marketing strategy. We're looking for a contract editorial writer who covers our category the way a trade journalist or industry analyst would – someone who already knows the outsourced customer support trust & safety landscape, and follows what the vendors and platforms are actually doing.

This is not a content marketing role. We're looking for someone who can interview our executives, read the industry data critically, surface the stories buried inside our client work, and shape all of it into pieces that people running digital operations actually want to read – published under our leaders' names and placed with the publications their peers already read.

If you've covered this beat at a trade publication, worked as an industry analyst, built original research that others cited, or ghostwritten executive bylines that didn't sound like press releases, we should talk.


What You'll Do

Editorial & Executive Voice

  • Ghostwrite executive articles for owned, social, and external distribution channels
  • Interview internal SMEs, clients, and partners to extract story angles and original perspectives
  • Develop sponsored editorial and co-authored pieces for targeted trade publishers
  • Support live programming – office hours, panel appearances, recurring conversations with senior ModSquad voices – including prep, framing, and turning recordings into written pieces

Research & Category Analysis

  • Track the CX, trust & safety, moderation, and outsourcing landscape – competitor positioning, vendor claims, analyst coverage, regulatory movement – and tell us where our point of view has room to land
  • Build data-led editorial: original surveys, benchmark analyses, state-of-the-industry pieces, and commentary grounded in real numbers
  • Read industry research critically and translate it into an argument a practitioner can use
  • Identify the stories our competitors are not telling

Client Storytelling

  • Partner with Account Management and Sales to identify client stories worth telling
  • Develop anonymized or attributed client stories that are specific and authentic, not templated
  • Build a repeatable process for sourcing, quantifying, and clearing client stories – including getting to business outcomes, not just a list of services delivered

What We're Looking For


Experience

  • Demonstrated experience covering or analyzing at least one of: customer experience, contact centers, BPO/outsourcing, trust & safety, content moderation, enterprise SaaS, or digital operations
  • A track record in journalism, trade publishing, industry analysis, or research writing – not general content marketing
  • Demonstrable executive ghostwriting, with published examples
  • Experience producing or interpreting original research – surveys, benchmark data, industry datasets

Skills

  • You can pull a story out of a 30-minute conversation with a busy executive
  • You can take a pile of ideas or a rough brief and build a coherent, logical argument
  • You know how trade publications work: pitching editorial angles, sponsored content, co-authorship, and when each is the right call
  • You can name the publications, newsletters, and analysts that matter in this category
  • Comfortable in plain text workflows, Markdown, and GitHub
  • You know how to diagram a sentence, apply the Paramedic Method from Revising Prose, or have read Several Short Sentences About Writing more than once and have thoughts about how to apply it editorially
  • You're allergic to AI slop
  • You're already thinking about how to improve this job description

Mindset

  • Operates with editorial judgment, not just execution; pushes back when a brief doesn't have a story yet
  • Fast and self-directed; sets their own production pace without heavy oversight
  • Comfortable working as an independent contractor alongside an in-house team

Compensation & Structure

  • This engagement is structured as an independent contractor arrangement and does not include employee benefits.
  • The initial engagement will run for six months, with the possibility of extension based on business needs and project volume.
  • The engagement is fully remote. Some availability during Pacific business hours may be needed for executive interviews and live programming; otherwise, the contractor may perform the services asynchronously.
  • The contractor will work with the Content & Creative Production team and collaborate with the Head of Brand and VP of Marketing.
  • Services will be requested on an as-needed basis, and weekly hours may vary depending on project volume.
  • Compensation will be paid hourly. The contractor will track time through Teambridge Systems and submit monthly invoices for services performed.
  • All work product created under the engagement will be subject to the intellectual property and work-product provisions of the contractor agreement.


Location Restrictions

U.S. Candidates: This engagement is not available to individuals who will perform services from New York City, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey. Contractors must perform services from an eligible U.S. location outside those jurisdictions for the duration of the engagement.


How To Apply

Send us:

  • Two writing samples that were published under someone else's name – an executive byline, a ghostwritten article, a placed piece. Tell us the outlet and roughly when. If the work is confidential, an anonymized version or a description of the engagement is fine; we understand ghostwriting is often unattributable.
  • One sample under your own byline – ideally something reported, analytical, or data-driven
  • A cover letter. We strongly encourage one. You're a writer, right? Write.

On AI: The cover letter and samples should be yours and we will be reading for that.


ModSquad is a fully remote company. We support clients in customer experience, content moderation, trust & safety, and digital engagement.


ModSquad is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, military status, status as a veteran or disabled veteran, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or family status, genetic information, medical condition, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.


Individual base pay depends on various factors, in addition to primary work location, such as complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. Although we have opportunities across the globe, this advertisement excludes individuals residing in California, Colorado, New York, and Washington at this time.
